shots.name: perspective-grid-inspector
shots.alt: The Perspective Grid card in Properties → Effects, open in its Grid, Motion and Look sections: Horizon 60 %, Columns 16, Row Density 6, Line Width 10 px, Lines Thin with depth, Speed 1.5 rows/s, Line Color, Opacity 1, Horizon Fade 1.4, Blend Add (glow); every number row has a keyframe diamond and a reset arrow

marks.label: Line Width of the nearest lines
Lines: thin with depth, or an even width

shots.name: stick-figure-inspector

marks.label: Preset: a whole figure at once
Use: apply or key a pose from the library
Gait: Walk, Run or Idle move every joint
Action lane: Walk, Jump and Punch on the figure's lane
Add: another action at the playhead

shots.alt: The Stick Figure card in Properties, Effects, with the Arabesque preset: the Preset menu, the folded sections Pose, Proportions, Ground and Style, then Pose library (Pose Stand, Apply, Key pose, Key easing, a Pose name field and Save pose), Motion (Walk, Run, Idle) and Actions with a lane holding Walk, Jump and Punch blocks, the Add menu, At playhead, Markers, a sound menu, Sounds and Check choreography
shots.caption: The Stick Figure card with the Arabesque preset and three actions, its parameter sections folded.
shots.note: Needs clicks (card buttons pressed first), collapse (card sections folded) and nodeClicks (Nodes toolbar buttons), which scripts/effect-editor-shot.mjs does not read yet: made with a review-folder copy that adds them (ledger, GEN1).

shots.name: stick-figure-pose

marks.label: Pelvis X: where the figure stands
Hip R: −100° lifts the leg behind

shots.alt: The Pose section of the Stick Figure card with the Arabesque preset: Pelvis X, Pelvis Y and Lift at 0 px, Spine Lean 20°, Head Tilt −14°, Shoulder L 150°, Elbow L 10°, Shoulder R −85°, Elbow R 6°, Hip L 0°, Knee L 0°, Hip R −100°, Knee R 0°, each with a slider, a keyframe diamond and a reset arrow
shots.caption: The Pose section with the Arabesque preset.
shots.note: Needs clicks (card buttons pressed first), collapse (card sections folded) and nodeClicks (Nodes toolbar buttons), which scripts/effect-editor-shot.mjs does not read yet: made with a review-folder copy that adds them (ledger, GEN1).

shots.name: stick-figure-walk-nodes

marks.label: Gait Cycle: one output per joint
Stick Figure: the joints as inputs

shots.alt: The Nodes tab after Walk: a Gait Cycle card on the left with inputs time, speed, stride, lean and phase and one output per joint (Spine to Knee R), cables from each output to the matching joint input of the Stick Figure card, which also takes the picture from the clip's Source card and passes it to Target
shots.caption: The node setup after Walk.
shots.note: Needs clicks (card buttons pressed first), collapse (card sections folded) nodeClicks (Nodes toolbar buttons) and title:<card> marks, which scripts/effect-editor-shot.mjs does not read yet: made with a review-folder copy that adds them (ledger, GEN1).
